goxlr.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to the GoXLR Utility right now.

goxlr.connect.description: Starts connecting to the GoXLR Utility. It does not wait: Cuebot keeps trying in the background until it works.
goxlr.connect.returns: true once connecting has started (not when it is connected).

goxlr.disconnect.description: Disconnects Cuebot from the GoXLR Utility.

goxlr.getStatus.description: Tells you about the GoXLR Utility connection and your GoXLR: profiles, faders, volumes, mutes and effects.
goxlr.getStatus.returns: isConnected, status (a status line), url, daemonVersion, devices (each GoXLR with its profile, faders, volumes in percent, cough button, effects and sampler bank), profiles, micProfiles and presets.

goxlr.getRawStatus.description: Gives you everything the GoXLR Utility reports, exactly as it sends it. For advanced scripts.
goxlr.getRawStatus.returns: The utility's whole status as JSON text. Empty text when nothing was received yet.

goxlr.setVolume.description: Changes the volume of one GoXLR channel. Fails with an error when the GoXLR Utility is not connected.

parameters.channel: The channel: Mic, LineIn, Console, System, Game, Chat, Sample, Music, Headphones, MicMonitor or LineOut.
parameters.relative: Optional. true adds the number to the current volume instead (use a minus number to turn it down). Default false.

goxlr.setFaderMute.description: Mutes or unmutes one GoXLR fader. Fails with an error when the GoXLR Utility is not connected or the channel is not on a fader.

parameters.target: The fader letter A, B, C or D, or the channel on it, like "Music".

goxlr.setFaderChannel.description: Puts a different channel on one of the GoXLR faders. Fails with an error when the GoXLR Utility is not connected.

parameters.fader: The fader letter: A, B, C or D.
parameters.channel: The channel to put on it, like "Game" or "Music".

goxlr.setCoughMute.description: Mutes or unmutes your mic with the cough button (on a GoXLR Mini: the mic mute button). Fails with an error when the GoXLR Utility is not connected.

goxlr.loadProfile.description: Loads one of your GoXLR profiles. Fails with an error when the GoXLR Utility is not connected.

parameters.name: The profile name as the GoXLR Utility shows it, like "Streaming".
parameters.remember: Optional. true makes the GoXLR Utility load this profile again next time it starts. Default true.

goxlr.loadMicProfile.description: Loads one of your GoXLR mic profiles. Fails with an error when the GoXLR Utility is not connected.

parameters.name: The mic profile name as the GoXLR Utility shows it, like "Dynamic Mic".
parameters.remember: Optional. true makes the GoXLR Utility load this mic profile again next time it starts. Default true.

goxlr.setEffect.description: Turns a voice effect on or off. The GoXLR Mini has no effects, so it fails with an error there.
goxlr.setEffect.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

goxlr.setEffectPreset.description: Picks one of the six effect presets. The GoXLR Mini has no effects, so it fails with an error there.

parameters.preset: The preset number 1-6, like "3", or its name.

goxlr.setEffectPreset.returns: The preset that is now active, like "Preset3".

goxlr.setSamplerBank.description: Switches the sampler to bank A, B or C. The GoXLR Mini has no sampler, so it fails with an error there.

goxlr.playSample.description: Plays a sample from a sampler button, as if you pressed it. The GoXLR Mini has no sampler, so it fails with an error there.

parameters.bank: Optional. The bank: "A", "B" or "C". Leave it empty for the bank that is active now.
parameters.index: Optional. Which sample on that button, counting from 1. Leave it out to play the button's next sample.

goxlr.playSample.returns: bank and button that were played.

goxlr.stopSample.description: Stops the sample that a sampler button is playing.

parameters.bank: Optional. The bank: "A", "B" or "C". Leave it empty for the bank that is active now.

goxlr.stopSample.returns: bank and button that were stopped.

goxlr.setRouting.description: Sends a GoXLR input to an output, or stops it, like the Routing table in the GoXLR Utility.

parameters.input: The input: Microphone, Chat, Music, Game, Console, LineIn, System or Samples.
parameters.output: The output: Headphones, BroadcastMix, ChatMic, Sampler, LineOut or StreamMix2.

goxlr.setRouting.returns: The new state: true when the input goes to the output, false when not.

goxlr.setGlobalColour.description: Changes the colour of all the lights on your GoXLR. Fails with an error when the colour is not a hex colour.

parameters.colour: The colour as a hex code, like "#FF8800".

goxlr.command.description: Sends a raw command to the GoXLR Utility. For advanced users who know the GoXLR Utility's command names.

parameters.command: The command, like {"SetFXEnabled": true}. You can also give it as JSON text.
parameters.serial: Optional. The serial number of the GoXLR to send it to. Leave it out for your main GoXLR.

goxlr.request.description: Sends any raw request to the GoXLR Utility and gives back its answer. For advanced users.

parameters.request: The request, like "GetStatus" or {"Command": [...]}. You can also give it as JSON text.

goxlr.request.returns: The GoXLR Utility's answer data, like "Ok" or the status object.
